pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through staging. The hero is usually a complete object, centered and upright or symmetrical, floating with even clearance on all sides. It is rarely cropped by an edge or pushed close at an angle the way real cards are. Slim subjects come out narrow with wide empty sides (tube, plant), and bulky ones can overfill (backpack). Thin parts disappear at thumbnail size, and added scene elements such as Earth arcs, towers and pads compete with the hero. The measured evidence shows this as margins at or above the real ceiling, or area and box width below the real floor.
